# TDPdf v1.23.4.0

**Fixes Insert Text Box still not accepting input after 1.23.3.0.**

A Windows smoke test confirmed that Signature and Draw work, while the text editor could still remain unfocused. The fallback that recognized a click inside the editor was preventing a replacement text box, but it only swallowed the underlying canvas click and did not restore keyboard focus.

TDPdf now explicitly focuses the active editor and positions its caret when that fallback is used. Initial focus also waits until queued mouse input has completed, and direct editor clicks reaffirm focus.

## For administrators

The Intune detection rule now requires 1.23.4.0, so managed machines pick this up on the next evaluation. Assignments are unaffected.

## Verifying this download

The executable is signed by *The Doodle Project Code Signing*, a private certificate. On managed machines that trust it, the signature validates. On a machine that does not, Windows will still warn on first run. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to confirm the download independently.
